The opera brought the composer a considerable reputation, although this did not materially affect his position in Hanover, where he was music director of the Court Theatre.  Like Marschner's other great success, "Der Vampyr", the plot of "Hans Heiling" makes great use of supernatural elements.  As with several of his operas, "Hans Heiling" is based on a folk legend.
